description.value:
Requirement You have a Marked quarry.

Designate a second creature as a Marked quarry. Your Mark's bonus against this second target is half its normal value, rounded down, and the second Mark ends when your first Mark does.

cinderfall.incomplete: The base Mark now exists (waywarden.mark-quarry.json grants TokenMark slug 'quarry'), but this card needs more than that predicate: TokenMark stores marks as a set of slugs per token on the actor (pf2e-source's token-mark rule-element.ts), so two different tokens can each carry the SAME 'quarry' slug -- there is no way to tell, from target:mark:quarry alone, which of the two is the full-value primary Mark and which is this card's half-value secondary one. Building this correctly needs a second, separately-tracked slug (e.g. 'quarry-secondary') AND a halved-value duplicate of every rule that currently reads target:mark:quarry across every other waywarden card that scales off the Mark -- a corpus-wide expansion, not a single-file fix. Left unbuilt as a scope decision rather than shipped half-correct.
